<div class="section_Sub">
<h2>Delta Dental gives employers more for their money.



</h2>
<div class="section_subContentWithImage">
<h4></h4>
<p>
</p><p><img alt="" src="/Resources/Thumbnails/Employer_HomePage.png" style="border-width: 5px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); float: left;"/>Delta Dental offers the largest networks for more convenience, more preventive services, substantial claims savings thanks to the deep discounts we negotiate with dentists...in short more value. Plus our Preventistry<span style="font-size: 8px;"><sup>TM</sup></span> approach is aimed at eliminating oral disease and keeping our members healthier.</p>
<a href="/employers/">
            Learn more</a>
<p></p>
</div><div class="section_subContentWithImage">
<h4></h4>
<p>
</p><h2>No dental plan through your place of employment? No worries.</h2>
<p><br/>
<img alt="" src="/Resources/Thumbnails/NoDentalPlan_HomePage-(1).png" style="border-width: 5px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); float: left;"/>Delta Dental has affordable dental plans and options to keep you and your family healthy and happy. Plans with the most dentists in the networks, great savings, easy to join and easy to use - no wonder Delta Dental has the most members.</p>
<a href="/dental-plans/individual-family-plans/">
            Learn more</a>
<p></p>
</div>
</div><!--end section_Sub-->
<div class="section_Sub">
<h2>Download the Delta Dental Mobile App today!



</h2>
<div class="section_subContentWithImage">
<h4></h4>
<p>
</p><p><img alt="My Mobile App" src="/Resources/Thumbnails/MobileApp_HomePage.png" style="border-width: 5px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); float: left; margin: 0px auto;"/>Manage your oral health. Anywhere.</p>
<p>We've gone mobile! Check our our FREE Mobile app that allows you to find a dentist, manage your coverage &amp; everything in between.<br/>
 </p>
<a href="/members/delta-dental-mobile-app/">
            Learn more <p> </p></a>
<p></p>
</div><div class="section_subContentWithImage">
<h4></h4>
<p>
</p><h2><br/>
Take advantage of these healthy living discounts.</h2>
<br/>
<img alt="Woman smiling" src="/Resources/Thumbnails/ValueBenefits_HomePage.png" style="border-width: 5px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); float: left;"/>
<div>Your health is valuable – perhaps the most valuable asset you have. That’s why it’s important to take care of yourself. To help you do just that, Delta Dental is offering special partner discounts on these self-care products for your oral and hearing health.<br/>
 <br/>
Supercharge your brushing routine with the <a href="/Dental-plans/Healthy-Living-Discounts/Sonic-Toothbrush-Discount">Z Sonic toothbrush offer</a><br/>
 <br/>
Amp up the audio with the <a href="/Dental-plans/Healthy-Living-Discounts/Hearing-Care-Package-Discount">Amplifon hearing care package</a></div>
<a href="">
</a>
<p></p>
</div>
